title: Warden Auditor output
description: Fixed contract between the Auditor, the Agent, and the iMessage + UI workstreams. Do not rename fields without telling every workstream. A LOW verdict means no flagged risk, never 'safe'.

chainId.description: EVM chain id. Sepolia is 11155111. Testnet only until Akul says otherwise.

verdict.description: Worst finding severity. No findings = LOW. There is no 'SAFE' or 'CLEAN' value.

riskScore.description: Provisional: 50 per high, 15 per medium, 5 per low finding, capped at 100.

verified.description: true = verified source was fetched and scanned. false = bytecode-only checks.

id.description: Detector id, e.g. reentrancy-state-after-call, tx-origin, eip7702-delegation.

message.description: Plain statement of what was found.
